Question #: 1.Title: Exam Certified CPQ Specialist topic 1 question 137 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: An admin has created a workflow rule to automatically generate the renewal Opportunity and Quote when a user activates the Contract. The Renewal Pricing Method is set to List. The original Quote contains only standalone fixed-price subscription products and non-subscription products.
What should the user see on the renewal Quote?
A. Optional products from the original Quote will pull into the renewal.
B. The renewal Quote start date will be the Contract end date plus one day.
C. All Quote Line items will be pulled through from the original Quote.
D. Additional discounts from the original Quote will automatically populate on the renewal.
